description: Digitální a informační agentura: pipeline datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Single Information Point Czechia , a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Digitální a informační agentura. Coverage: Digitální a informační agentura. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about pipeline; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: 684-153: Plynovodní potrubí; 1181-11: Základní báze geografických dat České republiky - Rozvodné sí; 684-117: Přepravní plynovod. Formats seen: XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/inventární-seznam/agendy/A684/subjekty-a-objekty-údajů/684-153/distribuce/1/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/inventární-seznam/agendy/A1181/subjekty-a-objekty-údajů/1181-11/distribuce/1/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/inventární-seznam/agendy/A684/subjekty-a-objekty-údajů/684-117/distribuce/1/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-cz.
